name: bake_into_a_pie_destroys_and_bakes_a_food
notes: M5 mapper. Printed: 'Destroy target creature. Create a Food token. (It's an artifact with "{2}, {T}, Sacrifice this token: You gain 3 life.")' Seat 0 destroys Opp Giant and makes one Food for itself; it pays {2}, {T} and sacrifices the Food: seat 0 gains 3 (seat 1 nothing) and no Food is left. A Food with {1} is not activatable (the 'words no ask took' refusal), as the ruling's food_needs_2_mana shows.
